title: AX4S/AX4N Automatic Transmission Failure
caption:
⚠️ Ford Windstar shifting rough? The AX4S/AX4N automatic is known for premature failure on 1996–2003 models.

Watch for harsh 1-2 shifts, slipping or shuddering during acceleration, and torque converter shudder around 40-55 mph. Common culprits include torque converter clutch solenoid problems and internal transmission wear. Repair costs can range from about $400 to $3,100 depending on the fix.
